in_marathi.name: Rupan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rupan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rupan means 'jewel' or 'wealth'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rup' which means 'form' or 'shape'. The name signifies the beauty and value that one holds within themselves.
